description: Many-to-many mapping between constitutional doctrines and landmark judgments in the seed package
notes: Basic Structure lineage: Golaknath (absolute bar) → Kesavananda (basic structure) → Indira Gandhi (elections) → Minerva Mills (limited amending power) → Bommai (secularism/federalism).
Maneka Gandhi expanded Article 21; Hussainara, Olga Tellis, Puttaswamy and Navtej continue that liberty/dignity line (linked by tags, not only this crosswalk).
Vishaka is an Article 141 law-declaring decision; Shreya Singhal is the leading free-speech vagueness case and also illustrates striking an entire provision.
Ultra Vires and Eclipse remain primarily statutory/constitutional construction doctrines in this seed set.
